blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo on Monday accused a defense witness of “lying through his teeth” during the 40th day of the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin took the witness stand in relation to the remaining article of impeachment against Duterte, which accuses her of amassing unexplained wealth and failing to truthfully declare all her assets. During his cross-examination of the witness, prosecution counsel and spokesperson Atty. Benjamin Tolosa Jr., showed Adalin Google Maps views of a property in Matina Crossing, Davao City allegedly belonging to Duterte’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. This […]...
